name: WARNING: Tacos al Pastor (Spicy Achiote, Guajillo Chile & Pineapple Marinade)
whyItWorks: Pork marinated in heavy paste of achiote, dried guajillo and ancho chiles, garlic, vinegar, and bromelain-rich raw pineapple juice, cooked on a vertical trompo. High acid + concentrated chili capsaicin sparks severe stomach and bowel burning.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Avoid al pastor. Choose unspiced carnitas or plain grilled chicken (pollo asado) instead.
